content:
**Percepti-Bobble** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Hear directional audio when in range of a Bobblehead.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | You hear directional audio when in range of a Bobblehead. | 003E956D | 

Works well with the Curator perk, which boosts the effects of any given bobblehead.
